title: Afghan Air Corps Recon of Crashed Pamir Airlines Passenger Jet
description: B-roll of U.S. Airmen mentoring Afghan Air Corps while they search for a crashed Pamir Airlines Passenger jet. Scenes include aerial shots from the helicopter of the mountains of Afghanistan and the crashed jet and an interview with Lt. Col. Gregory Roberts. Produced by Tech. Sgt. Mike Tateishi.
keywords: Afghan air corps, Pamir Airlines Passenger jet, Lt. Col. Gregory Roberts, Commander 438th Expeditionary Advisory Squadron, Afghanistan, search and rescue
